app.name: AI Ticket Monitoring
app.short_description: Review AI ticket satisfaction and session details.
app.long_description: A read-only dashboard for completed AI support monitoring sessions. It shows ticket-level satisfaction, session-level score breakdowns, searchable records, and monitoring details saved by the support platform in SQL Server. Estimated satisfaction is not Zendesk's official CSAT.
app.installation_instructions: This temporary build includes its monitoring backend hostname and report API key in the frontend. No connection settings are required.
